name: Yadulink
description: French B2B SaaS that turns LinkedIn buying signals (profile visits, post engagement, invitations) into outreach sequences, with lead lists, CRM, unified inbox, API/webhooks/MCP. Pricing: €99/mo Pro excl. VAT; custom for teams (company-stated). Founded Apr 2024, FR, 2–5 people, ~3,000 estimated users. Stack: Django/Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, HTMX, Unipile for LinkedIn. Listed for sale at $125,000 (1.6x; first listed Sep 29, 2026; 2 offers). Seller says the developer spends ≤3 hours/week on it (founder-stated).

mentions.evidence: ~$8,542 MRR (−5.0% L30), 136 active subscriptions, ~$6,570 L30 (+39.6%), ~$19,762 last 3 months, ~$104,502 last 12 months, ~$190,306 all-time, ~65% L30 profit margin. Revenue synced Oct 9, 2026 ~08:47 Warsaw (06:47 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Narrow to one ICP: "LinkedIn signal → sequence" for EU accounting / ERP consultants selling to SMBs, with Polish and German templates baked in. Or buy Yadulink and push PL/DE localization + agency reseller seats.

whyItPrints: LinkedIn prospecting tools are a crowded but still-paying category. 136 subs at ~$8.5k MRR with +39.6% L30 growth and a sub-2x ask is a "buy distribution, keep building" deal — not Conductor-lane, but a clean FR SaaS for sale.
